presentation.label: IMPROVED CONFIGS
presentation.summary: Four SEQUENCER CONFIG checkboxes: silent pad and TRIG selects, outside and in LIVE RECORDING; MUTE ALL SOUND, so a muted track stays silent while trigs record; PAD LEAVES FX, so a pad takes you off the FX track.
presentation.overview: Improved Configs (Silent Pad+Trig Settings until 0.8.0) adds four checkboxes to GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, after AUTO TRK SWITCH. SILENT PAD+TRIG covers every state but LIVE and STEP RECORDING: a pad or TRIG key 1-12 press selects its track and stays silent, with no MIDI note. SILENT P+T LIVEREC covers LIVE RECORDING: a pad or TRIG key press selects its track silently and records nothing. With either, hold FUNC and press a pad to play it at the pad's own velocity, or a TRIG key to play its track at the TRIG page's VEL; in LIVE RECORDING both also record. MUTE ALL SOUND extends a mute: on stock a muted track skips its sequencer trigs but still plays from pads, TRIG keys and MIDI; checked, those start no voice and send no MIDI note on either, in any state, and LIVE RECORDING still lays down the trig. Aftertouch is untouched. PAD LEAVES FX: with the FX track up, a pad or TRIG key press that selects its track leaves the FX track for that track's page, as TRK + pad does, where stock keeps the FX track on screen. All four default to unchecked, are kept per GLOBAL slot and are saved with the project.
highlights: Tap pads to pick tracks without hearing them, while editing or while live recording, each switched on its own.
Mute a track and record into it in silence: pads, TRIG keys and MIDI make no sound, and the trigs still go down.
FUNC + pad plays and records, at the pad's own velocity; FUNC + TRIG plays at the TRIG page's VEL.
With the FX track up, tap a pad and land on that track's page, as TRK + pad does.
Four checkboxes per GLOBAL slot, kept through a power cycle; unchecked is stock.
usage: Use a build containing Improved Configs. Open the GLOBAL menu, then CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG. After AUTO TRK SWITCH are SILENT PAD+TRIG, SILENT P+T LIVEREC, MUTE ALL SOUND and PAD LEAVES FX; check any with YES or LEFT/RIGHT.

With SILENT PAD+TRIG checked and the sequencer stopped, tap the SD pad: it makes no sound and the SD track is selected. Hold FUNC and tap SD to hear it at the pad's own velocity. TRIG 5 selects track 5 silently; FUNC + TRIG 5 plays it at VEL.

With SILENT P+T LIVEREC checked, press RECORD + PLAY for LIVE RECORDING: plain pad and TRIG key taps stay silent and record nothing; hold FUNC and tap a pad or TRIG key to play and record it. Uncheck both to get stock behaviour everywhere.
With MUTE ALL SOUND checked, mute BD in MUTE mode, press RECORD + PLAY and tap BD: you hear nothing. Stop, unmute BD and play: the trigs you tapped are there.
With PAD LEAVES FX and AUTO TRK SWITCH checked, press FX to show the FX track, then tap SD: the SD track's page comes up, as with TRK + SD. FX takes you back to the FX track.

access.location: GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG: SILENT PAD+TRIG, SILENT P+T LIVEREC, MUTE ALL SOUND and PAD LEAVES FX, after AUTO TRK SWITCH.
steps: Open the GLOBAL menu and choose CONTROL, then SEQUENCER CONFIG.
Move to SILENT PAD+TRIG, SILENT P+T LIVEREC, MUTE ALL SOUND or PAD LEAVES FX, just after AUTO TRK SWITCH, and press YES (or RIGHT) to check it.

controls.name: SILENT PAD+TRIG
controls.doc: Checkbox in GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, after AUTO TRK SWITCH. YES toggles it, RIGHT checks, LEFT unchecks. Checked: outside LIVE and STEP RECORDING, pads and TRIG keys 1-12 select their track silently. Kept per GLOBAL slot.

controls.name: SILENT P+T LIVEREC
controls.doc: Checkbox after SILENT PAD+TRIG. YES toggles it, RIGHT checks, LEFT unchecks. Checked: in LIVE RECORDING, pads and TRIG keys 1-13 are silent and record nothing; pads and TRIG 1-12 select their track. Kept per GLOBAL slot.

controls.name: MUTE ALL SOUND
controls.doc: Checkbox after SILENT P+T LIVEREC. YES toggles it, RIGHT checks, LEFT unchecks. Checked: a pad, TRIG key or MIDI note starts no voice on a muted track, or on one silenced by another track's solo, and a pad or TRIG key sends no MIDI note on. Recording is untouched. Kept per GLOBAL slot.

controls.name: PAD LEAVES FX
controls.doc: Checkbox after MUTE ALL SOUND. YES toggles it, RIGHT checks, LEFT unchecks. Checked: with the FX track selected, a pad or TRIG 1-12 press that selects its track (AUTO TRK SWITCH, RTRG + pad, the SILENT rows) leaves the FX track for that track's page, as TRK + pad does. Kept per GLOBAL slot.

controls.name: FUNC + pad
controls.doc: Where a checked setting applies, plays the pad's track at the strike's velocity, or the fixed velocity with FIX on (stock FUNC + pad uses the TRIG page's VEL); records it in LIVE RECORDING; selects the track only if AUTO TRK SWITCH is checked, as stock.

controls.name: FUNC + TRIG 1-13
controls.doc: Where SILENT PAD+TRIG or SILENT P+T LIVEREC applies, plays the track at the TRIG page's VEL, as a plain TRIG press does on stock, and records it in LIVE RECORDING; selects the track only if AUTO TRK SWITCH is checked, as stock. Stock plays nothing there. GRID and STEP RECORDING keep stock's FUNC + TRIG.

controls.name: Pad held down
controls.doc: Aftertouch, as stock: modulates the track's AFTERTOUCH destinations and sends MIDI poly pressure, also after a silent press.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.3.

0.5.x (PS07, PS08), 0.6.0 (PS10 to PS12), 0.7.0 (PS14, PS16), 0.8.0 (in the combined build AT04) and 0.9.0 (in the combined build PC01) ran on a unit, as reported. MIDI out, STEP REC and MIDI notes in are not yet tested on a unit.

A note already ringing when you mute keeps ringing, as stock: MUTE ALL SOUND stops new hits and does not cut the voice or the delay and reverb tails. In LIVE RECORDING a muted pad's hit still sets the track's pitch and velocity, so a note the track itself still rings can change pitch.

The SOUND BROWSER's audition reaches the voice by another path, so it still plays on a muted track, on purpose (read in the code, not tested). A muted hit runs no envelope or LFO trig. MIDI out gets no note on or poly pressure from a muted pad, but its release still sends a note off, which a receiver ignores.

FUNC + TRIG is stock in GRID and STEP RECORDING: it places a trig in GRID RECORDING and plays and selects in STEP RECORDING. Elsewhere stock's FUNC + TRIG plays nothing, and the module makes it play where TRIG keys are silent. 0.7.0 renames the row from SILENT PAD LIVEREC to SILENT P+T LIVEREC.

With the SILENT rows, a silent press passes its aftertouch on, so MIDI out can carry poly pressure with no note-on before it. MUTE ALL SOUND stops poly pressure on a muted track; the pressure still reaches the sound, so it can modulate a ringing note.
TRIG 13 (the FX track), the SOUND BROWSER's pad audition and pads with a menu open are silent too; FUNC + pad and FUNC + TRIG play.
RTRG + pad selects silently; FUNC + RTRG also toggles the metronome click, as on stock, so it is not a clean way to roll.

A unit that ran 0.6.x starts 0.7.0 with its rows unchecked when linked alone: the LIVE REC row's storage field is renamed, which changes the storage layout, so check the rows again once. The same held from 0.5.x to 0.6.0 and from 0.4.x to 0.5.x.
A unit that ran 0.8.0 starts 0.9.0 with its rows unchecked when linked alone: PAD LEAVES FX's storage field changes the storage layout, so check the rows again once.
In LIVE RECORDING a muted pad's dropped hit lights its pad at a fixed level that fades as a sound's light does; it does not follow the hit's velocity.
A GLOBAL slot saved without a setting, or received as Global SysEx, loads it unchecked.
LIVE RECORDING counts only while the sequencer runs; a paused LIVE REC follows SILENT PAD+TRIG.

Like stock's SEQUENCER CONFIG rows, a changed row is saved when you leave the menu: power off straight from SEQUENCER CONFIG and the change is lost (seen on a unit, with KIT RELOAD ON CHG behaving the same).

PAD LEAVES FX leaves the FX track on every press that selects a track, the one FX would return to included. With AUTO TRK SWITCH unchecked a pad that plays selects nothing and FX stays up; a silent press from the SILENT rows always selects, so it leaves FX. MIDI notes in, CHROMATIC, PERF and SCENE pads never select and stay stock.

load.display: A few compares per track each audio block, and per pad, TRIG key or MIDI note
load.conditions: Static: the sites are in KeyboardView's pad and TRIG key handlers, their shared play routine, its voice trigger call, the audio block's trig loop and pad glow store, both pad views' MIDI note on and poly pressure, and the SEQUENCER CONFIG menu's constructor; each press or note reads the record state and the mute masks, and one storage bit for a muted track. The audio block's trig loop gains a few compares per track (13 a block) and its pad glow store a table read per track (12 a block), and the tick reads MUTE ALL SOUND about 20 times a second for it. Not a measurement.

hardware.summary: npp1993 (the author) ran 0.9.0 on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, in the combined build PC01 (RC45's 17 modules with this source), RAM-booted, 22 Nov 2026, as reported: with PAD LEAVES FX checked and AUTO TRK SWITCH unchecked, FX then the MT pad brought up MT, and FX then CH brought up CH; TRK + pad behaved the same; plain pads selected silently and FUNC + pad played without selecting, as SILENT PAD+TRIG documents. Earlier versions: 0.8.0 (AT04), 0.7.0 (PS14, PS16), 0.6.0 (PS10 to PS12), 0.5.x (PS07, PS08); details in TESTING.md.
limitations: 0.9.0 ran on a unit only in PC01, a combined build RAM-booted over the development link, not alone and not flashed, so the row's survival across a power cycle was not tested on a unit.

The run was with AUTO TRK SWITCH unchecked; TRIG keys, RTRG + pad, LIVE RECORDING and AUTO TRK SWITCH checked were tested only in rytm-emu. Results are as reported by the author, not itemized measurements.
PC01 SysEx b0f8b76b63156f36fbc5e3dd4a7f3294aff195f5ec7afd26ae7f1a70c0c991f6; firmware was not read back from the device.
Earlier versions' limits stay as TESTING.md records them: MIDI out, STEP REC and MIDI notes in were not tested on a unit.

tests.summary: Emulator (rytm-emu, OS 1.74). 0.9.0 (PF01): PAD LEAVES FX checked, SD, BD, TRIG 3, RTRG + SD, FUNC + SD, a silent SD and SD in LIVE REC leave the FX track for their track's page; unchecked, or with AUTO TRK SWITCH off, the FX track stays up as stock. 0.8.0 (AT04E): RTRG + muted CH in LIVE REC is sample-identical to no press while its series runs. 0.7.0 (PS14): FUNC + TRIG plays at VEL where plain TRIG is silent. 0.6.0 (PS12): MUTE ALL SOUND gives digital zero. 0.5.0 to 0.8.0 ran on a unit.
